subject: [PATCH v2 08/10] mm/madvise: separate the PTL-held PTE scan

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch separates the PTE (Page Table Entry) scan into two functions: madvise_lru_pte_range_locked() and madvise_lru_pmd_entry(). The new function, madvise_lru_pte_range_locked(), runs entirely under the lock and stops either at a folio to split or at the reschedule point. This allows for more efficient handling of large-folio splits and periodic rescheduling. No functional changes are intended by this patch.
